name: image_reducepoly
expr: Rd = reducepoly(P); R1 = reducepoly(P, 0.1); Rc = reducepoly(C, 0.01); Rt = reducepoly(T, 0.1); R0 = reducepoly(P, 0); Rg = reducepoly([0 0; 5 5], 0.5);
comment: MATLAB Image Toolbox reducepoly — Ramer-Douglas-Peucker polyline simplification. tolerance in [0,1] normalised by the bbox diagonal norm(max(P)-min(P)); 0 -> eps (minimal reduction), 1 -> endpoints only. Recursive split at the vertex with max chord-perpendicular distance (|det([1 x y; ...])|/chordLen), first-farthest wins on ties; a run collapses to its endpoints once max deviation <= tolerance. Output rows are exact copies of retained input vertices; class preserved (integer computed in single, cast back). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: default keeps 6 of 7 (drops the vertex collinear with its neighbours), tol>=0.1 keeps only endpoints, collinear -> 2, triangle-wave -> all 5. Bit-equal (tol=1e-12). Octave 11.1.0 ships reducepoly in the image package only -> reports N/A there.
